module.name: OpenShift Cluster Connection
module.description: Validates and connects to an existing OpenShift cluster

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Name identifier for this OCP cluster

optional.name: kubeconfig_content
optional.description: Kubeconfig YAML content for the OCP cluster. Automatically superseded by the project's registered-cluster kubeconfig when one exists; only used when no registered cluster is present, e.g. standalone or manual runs.

optional.name: skip_tls_verify
optional.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (use only for self-signed certs in dev/test)

key_outputs.name: kubeconfig_content
key_outputs.description: Kubeconfig YAML content for the connected OCP cluster

key_outputs.name: cluster_name
key_outputs.description: Name identifier for the connected OCP cluster

key_outputs.name: cluster_endpoint
key_outputs.description: API server endpoint URL for the connected OCP cluster
